newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dassault suspended twice on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Dassault suspended twice on Tuesday.

text.p: Shares in Dassault Aviation were twice suspended on Tuesday and would requote at 0900 GMT, a spokeswoman for the SBF French Stockmarkets Association said.
The share, suspended all day on Monday, was first suspended limit down on Tuesday and then limit-up.
The share, which closed at 1,230 francs on Friday, now has an upper limit of 1,110 and a lower limit of 1,056.
Dassault Aviation is set to merge with larger state-owned aerospace group Aerospatiale and dealers fear a left wing government may delay or cancel the operation.
